title: Corrupted and Voter Gear

image.alt: Corrupted and Voter armour are enchanted netherite

summary: **Corrupted and Voter Gear** are enchanted netherite sets from crates: Corrupted gear from the Chroma Crate and Voter armour from the Vote Crate.

blocks.p: Neither set has a recipe. Both come only from [crates](/wiki/smp/crates/).

ul: {{icon:netherite_chestplate}} Corrupted gear: armour, the Corrupted Blade, a pickaxe, axe and shovel, and the Corrupted Elytra, from the Chroma Crate.
{{icon:netherite_helmet}} Voter armour: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots, from the Vote Crate. You get a Vote Key for every [vote](/wiki/smp/voting/).
Neither set has a set bonus or a special ability: what you get is the enchants.
They are not on the keep-on-death list, which covers Chromatic, Halloween and Living Prism gear. See [Keep-on-Death Gear](/wiki/smp/keep-on-death/).
